families.types de données/descripteurs/flags/swiz: Data types, descriptors, flags and swizzle

buffers.mapped-at-creation.title: Write initial buffer contents
buffers.mapped-at-creation.expectation: A buffer created mapped exposes its whole mapping immediately and becomes unmapped after unmap.

transfers.copy-offsets.title: Copy a byte sub-range between buffers
transfers.copy-offsets.expectation: A buffer-to-buffer copy honours byte offsets and sizes and leaves the rest of the destination untouched.

transfers.write-offsets.title: Write a data sub-range through the queue
transfers.write-offsets.expectation: writeBuffer writes from a data offset with an explicit size.

transfers.write-remaining.title: Write from a data offset to the end of the data
transfers.write-remaining.expectation: writeBuffer with the size omitted writes from the offset to the end of the data.

buffers.partial-map-remap.title: Read a mapped sub-range then remap the whole buffer
buffers.partial-map-remap.expectation: Read an aligned range then remap the whole buffer without keeping the invalidated view.

compute.auto-layout-constants.title: Dispatch with an automatic layout and a specialization constant
compute.auto-layout-constants.expectation: A compute pipeline with an automatic layout compiles and the specialization constant changes the dispatch result.

compute.explicit-layout-entrypoint.title: Dispatch with an explicit layout and an inferred entry point
compute.explicit-layout-entrypoint.expectation: A compute pipeline accepts an explicit layout and infers the entry point when the shader has a single one.

errors.empty-scope.title: An empty validation scope resolves to null
errors.empty-scope.expectation: A validation scope with no operation resolves to null and the scope stack stays balanced.

errors.invalid-buffer-usage.title: A buffer with no usage reports a validation error
errors.invalid-buffer-usage.expectation: An invalid creation is captured by the validation scope as a GPUValidationError.

errors.map-alignment.title: An unaligned mapping offset fails validation
errors.map-alignment.expectation: A mapping offset not aligned to 8 bytes fails validation and leaves the buffer unmapped.

buffers.map-destroyed.title: Mapping a destroyed buffer reports a validation error
buffers.map-destroyed.expectation: Mapping a destroyed buffer fails and cannot be reported as a success.

buffers.zero-initialized.title: Read a freshly created buffer
buffers.zero-initialized.expectation: A buffer reads back as zeros before anything writes to it.

buffers.map-write-roundtrip.title: Write through a mapped buffer
buffers.map-write-roundtrip.expectation: Mapped CPU writes are visible after unmapping and staging the buffer.

transfers.clear-buffer-range.title: Clear a byte range of a buffer
transfers.clear-buffer-range.expectation: clearBuffer zeroes only the requested byte range and leaves the rest unchanged.

transfers.copy-remaining.title: Copy the remaining source bytes
transfers.copy-remaining.expectation: Omitting the size copies from the source offset to the end of the source.

bindings.buffer-range.title: Bind an explicit buffer range
bindings.buffer-range.expectation: A buffer binding offset and size select the aligned range the shader reads.

bindings.dynamic-uniform-offsets.title: Move a uniform binding with a dynamic offset
bindings.dynamic-uniform-offsets.expectation: Each dynamic offset selects a different aligned block of the same uniform buffer.

compute.indirect-dispatch.title: Dispatch workgroups from an indirect buffer
compute.indirect-dispatch.expectation: dispatchWorkgroupsIndirect takes its workgroup counts from the indirect buffer.

compute.ordered-passes.title: Order two compute passes in one submission
compute.ordered-passes.expectation: A later compute pass sees the value written by the earlier pass in the same submission.

transfers.write-texture-tight-rows.title: Upload tightly packed rows with writeTexture
transfers.write-texture-tight-rows.expectation: writeTexture accepts a row stride that is not a multiple of 256 and preserves the row order.

transfers.upload-padded-rows.title: Skip inter-row padding in a buffer-to-texture copy
transfers.upload-padded-rows.expectation: copyBufferToTexture reads rows at bytesPerRow, so padding bytes never reach the texels.

transfers.readback-offset-padding.title: Read texels back at an offset and stride
transfers.readback-offset-padding.expectation: copyTextureToBuffer writes at the destination offset and stride and leaves the other bytes untouched.

transfers.array-layer-stride.title: Stride between array layers
transfers.array-layer-stride.expectation: rowsPerImage and bytesPerRow set the layer stride of an array-texture upload.

transfers.write-subrectangle.title: Write a texture sub-rectangle
transfers.write-subrectangle.expectation: writeTexture changes only the addressed rectangle and keeps the surrounding texels.

transfers.texture-region-copy.title: Copy a texture region
transfers.texture-region-copy.expectation: copyTextureToTexture copies the addressed rectangle to the destination origin and leaves the rest unchanged.

transfers.mip-level-copy.title: Copy one mip level
transfers.mip-level-copy.expectation: copyTextureToTexture addresses a single mip level and ignores the others.

transfers.volume-slices.title: Copy depth slices of a 3D texture
transfers.volume-slices.expectation: One buffer image feeds each depth slice of a 3D texture copy.

textures.view-base-mip.title: Start a view at a mip level
textures.view-base-mip.expectation: A view's baseMipLevel selects the mip level its level 0 reads.

textures.view-base-layer.title: Start a view at an array layer
textures.view-base-layer.expectation: A view's baseArrayLayer selects the first array layer its local indices address.

textures.view-dimensions.title: Report dimensions relative to a view
textures.view-dimensions.expectation: textureDimensions and textureNumLevels are relative to the view's base level and level count.

textures.uint-load.title: Load integer texels exactly
textures.uint-load.expectation: A texture_2d<u32> load returns the stored words without float conversion.

textures.storage-write.title: Write a storage texture from compute
textures.storage-write.expectation: textureStore writes each texel addressed by the dispatch and the readback returns them exactly.

textures.srgb-decode.title: Decode an sRGB texel on load
textures.srgb-decode.expectation: Loading RGBA8UnormSrgb linearises RGB while alpha is used as-is.

textures.srgb-view-format.title: Read the same bytes through a linear and an sRGB view
textures.srgb-view-format.expectation: A viewFormats entry lets two views of one texture read the bytes linearly or sRGB-decoded.

textures.cube-faces.title: Sample the six cube faces
textures.cube-faces.expectation: A cube view maps each axis direction to its layer and a nearest sample returns that layer's colour.

sampling.nearest.title: Sample with nearest filtering
sampling.nearest.expectation: Nearest filtering picks the texel under the coordinate with no blending.

sampling.linear.title: Sample with linear filtering
sampling.linear.expectation: Linear filtering blends the two texels around the coordinate.

sampling.clamp.title: Clamp texture coordinates at the edge
sampling.clamp.expectation: ClampToEdge uses the edge texel for coordinates outside 0..1.

sampling.repeat.title: Wrap texture coordinates with repeat
sampling.repeat.expectation: Repeat maps coordinates outside 0..1 to their fractional part.

sampling.mirror-repeat.title: Mirror texture coordinates
sampling.mirror-repeat.expectation: MirrorRepeat reflects each period, mapping the opposite way from repeat.

sampling.explicit-mip.title: Select a mip level explicitly
sampling.explicit-mip.expectation: An explicit LOD selects the matching mip level.

sampling.linear-mip.title: Blend adjacent mip levels
sampling.linear-mip.expectation: A linear mipmap filter blends the two mip levels around the requested LOD.

sampling.lod-clamp.title: Clamp the requested LOD
sampling.lod-clamp.expectation: lodMinClamp and lodMaxClamp bound the LOD a sample uses.

behaviours.adapter.request-and-capabilities: Requesting an adapter exposes its features, limits and description; the request may fail explicitly.
behaviours.device.features-and-limits: A device exposes the negotiated features and limits, plus the description of the adapter that created it.
behaviours.device.request-required-features: A missing required feature or limit fails the device request instead of producing a degraded device.
behaviours.command.encoder-recording: An encoder records commands and produces a command buffer submitted once.
behaviours.command.debug-markers: Debug markers wrap commands without changing observable results.
behaviours.transfers.texture-copy-aspect: A texture copy can select the depth or stencil aspect of a combined format.
behaviours.shader.compilation-info: Compilation messages are available with their severity and position, without requiring an exact text.
behaviours.compute.pipeline-async: Asynchronous creation resolves a ready-to-use pipeline or fails explicitly.
behaviours.compute.pass-descriptor: The compute pass descriptor carries the optional timestamp writes.
behaviours.texture.creation: A texture exposes its dimensions, format and usages; an invalid combination fails validation.
behaviours.texture.view-usage-aspect: A view can restrict its usages and select a texture aspect.
behaviours.texture.view-swizzle: A non-identity swizzle produces the expected DOMString and requires the texture-component-swizzle feature.
behaviours.sampler.comparison: A comparison sampler reports its compare function and comparison binding type.
behaviours.texture.usage-and-formats: Texture usages combine and each format declares its binding and attachment capabilities.
behaviours.render.color-load-store: Load and store operations preserve, replace or resolve the colour attachment content.
behaviours.render.depth.load-store: Load and store operations preserve or replace depth according to the descriptor.
behaviours.render.pass-descriptor: The pass descriptor assembles the attachments and pass state, and the pass writes to the attachments.
behaviours.render.occlusion-queries: An occlusion query wraps draw calls and its results are written to the query set.
behaviours.render.pipeline.creation: A render pipeline compiles the vertex/fragment state and describes its colour targets and blends.
behaviours.render.vertex-state: Vertex layouts link buffers and attributes to shader locations, and the draw commands consume them.
behaviours.render.primitive-and-multisample: Topology, culling and multisampling are validated against the pass attachments.
behaviours.render.depth-stencil-state: The pipeline depth/stencil state is compatible with the pass attachment format.
behaviours.render.pipeline-async: Asynchronous creation resolves a ready render pipeline or fails explicitly.
behaviours.renderbundle.record-and-execute: A render bundle records reusable commands and does not share the executing pass state.
behaviours.query.create-and-resolve: A query set exposes its type and count, and resolveQuerySet writes results into a buffer.
behaviours.query.timestamp-writes: Timestamp writes wrap a compute or render pass and require the timestamp-query feature.
behaviours.errors.uncaptured-error: An uncaptured error is delivered to the device callback and cannot become an apparent success.
behaviours.errors.device-lost: A device loss exposes an actionable reason and message to the runner.
behaviours.async.promise-results: Asynchronous operations distinguish success, validation rejection and implementation error.
behaviours.data.identifiers-and-indices: Size, index and coordinate aliases carry the contract units, and the base descriptors expose a label.
